promo-stroke-limit.title: Your Canva drawings are not being saved #shorts
promo-stroke-limit.description: Canva has a stroke limit of 1 MB per design - not per page, per design. Past it, Canva stops SAVING your drawings while still letting you draw them. The brush works, the strokes appear, nothing is written to the file. You find out when you refresh. The fix takes ten seconds: duplicate the design when a page is finished and carry on in the copy. Full Canva draw tool tutorial on the channel.

promo-pause-one-second.title: Draw it badly, then wait one second #shorts
promo-pause-one-second.description: You do not need a steady hand in Canva. Draw the shape, then hold still for one second before you lift - Canva snaps it into a clean one. It works on rectangles, arrows, triangles, circles, stars, lines, hearts and diamonds. Lift straight away and nothing happens, which is exactly why almost nobody finds it. Full Canva draw tool tutorial on the channel.
